basic_info.description: 1645 Pacific Apt. #2D is a south-facing residence, located in a boutique, doorman elevator building in a prime location at the crossroads of Nob Hill, Russian Hill and Pacific Heights. Well-located with many great restaurants, coffee shops and tech shuttles close by. This light-filled condominium with 2-bedroom, 2 bath, plus a large home office is stylishly appointed with Carrera marble counters, backsplash and bath surrounds, Waterworks plumbing fixtures, Thermador built-in refrigerator, Bertazzoni gas range, Bosch dishwasher. Added luxuries include air conditioning, Nest thermostat and in-unit washer and dryer. A common roof-top terrace offers incredible vistas across the city, San Francisco bay, Marin and the iconic Golden Gate Bridge. One-car parking, deeded storage and a bicycle room. The building is certified LEED Silver and known for its architecture and detailed relief on the facade. With a walk score of 99, this is a rare opportunity to buy into one of the city's most prestigious contemporary buildings.
